definitions.explanation: An individual board or plank used to construct a wooden floor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{床板|ゆかいた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}り{替|か}える→張り替える：28418_harikaeru⟧。

⟦{築|ちく}→築：29014_chiku⟧100⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{古民家|こみんか}→古民家：11833_kominka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{床板|ゆかいた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{黒光|くろびか}り⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じさせる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: The floorboards of the 100-year-old traditional house gleam black, giving a sense of long history.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧ (floor) and ⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧ (board, plank). Refers to the individual planks that make up a floor, as opposed to ⟦{床材|ゆかざい}→床材：25463_yukazai⟧ which is the more general term for flooring material.

In traditional Japanese architecture, {床板|ゆかいた} is often made of ⟦{檜|ひのき}→檜：04402_hinoki⟧ (Japanese cypress) or other domestic woods. Old floorboards that have been polished by generations of use develop a distinctive dark sheen.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {床板|ゆかいた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧きしむ: the floorboards creak
- {床板|ゆかいた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: to lay floorboards
- {床板|ゆかいた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}り{替|か}える→張り替える：28418_harikaeru⟧: to replace floorboards
- {床板|ゆかいた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{隙間|すきま}→隙間：00389_sukima⟧: gaps between floorboards

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{床材|ゆかざい}→床材：25463_yukazai⟧: flooring material — the broader term for any floor covering material
- {板|いた}の{間|ま}: wooden-floored room — a room with wooden floors as opposed to tatami
- ⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧: veranda; engawa — the wooden-floored corridor along the edge of a traditional house
